required_github_controls: Remove every organization member, outside collaborator, team member, and ruleset bypass actor whose login does not match the suffix.
Use active rulesets or branch protection on every protected branch and tag; disable administrator bypass where GitHub permits it.
Audit organization and repository audit-log events for membership, permission, settings, review, and update actions.
Keep the GitHub owner/admin account and every bypass actor individually verified; GitHub has no documented wildcard suffix principal.
